PoC 2: the income follows the #NFT🚗

Our robot car's Machine-NFT moved from CarOwner A to CarOwner B on @peaq .

The next delivery: the buyer locks 0.2 #SOL in a @solana escrow, the car scans the QR code, checks who owns it, and pays B. Not A.

Every step on-chain👇

Yesterday we pitched RoboPay at the Lucid Ventures x World's Fair Pitch Roast by @SuperteamDE 🔥

Here's our PoC 1 demo: a robot car that gets paid on-chain after delivery 🤖⚡

🔐 @Staex_io : secure machine connectivity
🆔 @peaq : machine identity
💸 @solana : escrow payments
